use_when: To turn a setting on or off, such as notifications or sound
For a single option with two clear states
When the change takes effect right away, with no Save button

dont_use_when.use_instead: radio buttons or a selection component

dont_use_when.when: When the choice is only applied after a Submit or Save button.
For an action such as "Delete" or "Send".

best_practice: Put a clear label beside the toggle that describes the setting, such as "Email notifications".
Place toggles in one aligned column, with the label on the left and the toggle on the right.
Use Disabled only when the setting is unavailable, and explain why nearby.
Don't use a toggle for something risky without a confirmation step.

variant_intent.checked=true: Figma "Checked? True": the setting is on.
variant_intent.checked=false: Figma "Checked? False": the setting is off.
variant_intent.state=Focus: Pins the focus look, for docs (code).
variant_intent.state=Disabled: Disables the toggle. Figma: use Disabled only when the setting is unavailable, and explain why nearby.

placement: Place toggles in one aligned column, with the label on the left and the toggle on the right.

a11y.fact: Renders a native <button role="switch"> with aria-checked, so it is announced as a switch that is on or off.
Space and Enter toggle it, and it takes keyboard focus.
A disabled toggle is natively disabled.
Shows a focus ring on keyboard focus.
